purpose: Calculation-readiness and deterministic-assistant rules. Facts may be official/wiki-sourced, directly observed, derived, partial, or unknown.

rules.name: Combat defence routing
facts: Monster Defence reduces incoming physical damage from Melee and Archery attacks.
Monster Magic Defence reduces incoming damage from Magic attacks.
There is no separate monster Archery Defence field in the current monster model.
notes: Player equipment may describe bonuses in style-specific wording, but monster records use Defence and Magic Defence.

rules.name: Monster weaknesses
facts: Attacking a monster with its listed weakness increases the player's hit chance and damage.
A monster with no listed weakness takes normal damage from all sources.
unknowns: Exact hit-chance bonus from weakness is not yet established in the Companion mechanics model.
The complete numerical damage modifier for every weakness subtype is not yet normalized.

rules.name: Combat skill progression
facts: Melee, Archery and Magic grant 8 skill XP per point of damage dealt.
Each of Melee, Archery and Magic gains +1 style damage per 10 skill levels.

rules.name: Combat numerical formulas
known: Monster records expose HP, Damage, Accuracy, Defence, Magic Defence and Weakness.
Player state visible through FlatStats includes current/max HP, Accuracy, style damage, Defence, Magic Defence and equipped items.
unknowns: A defensible generic recommended combat-level formula.
rules.policy: Do not invent exact hit chance, DPS, kill time, survivability, or recommended combat level until the required formulas are verified.

rules.name: Health and death
facts: A fresh account has been directly observed at 10/10 HP.
Health increases maximum HP by 1 per Health level.
The documented normal maximum is 109 HP at Health level 100.
Normal death respawns the player in Everbrook without item loss.

rules.name: Run
facts: Run is an Agility active ability measured in steps.
Higher Agility increases maximum Run steps before level 20.
At Agility level 20, running is unlimited outside combat.
At Agility level 40, running is allowed during combat.

observations.fact: Fresh low-level account screenshot showed Run at 200/200 steps.
User's Agility-20 account confirms unlimited running outside combat and that combat still cancels Run.

unknowns: Exact maximum-step progression/formula for Agility levels 1-19 is pending direct observations.

rules.name: Dodge
facts: Dodge is available from Agility level 1 and avoids the next attack.
Base Dodge cooldown is 60 seconds.
Agility level 30 unlocks a second Dodge slot.
Agility level 40 allows Run during combat.
Agility level 50 unlocks another Dodge slot.
At level 60, a successful Dodge makes the player attack on the next possible tick.
At level 70, Dodge cooldown is reduced to 40 seconds.

rules.name: Sleep Points
facts: Sleep Points are separate from Run steps.
Achievements can increase maximum Sleep Points.
Beds restore Sleep Points.
Many actions consume one Sleep Point.
When Sleep Points reach zero, XP gain stops.

observations.fact: Fresh account screenshot showed the Zzz resource at 25/25.
Production skills appear unavailable at 0 Sleep Points.

unknowns: Whether every action consumes exactly 1 Sleep Point.
Exact 0-Sleep behaviour for each skill/activity category.
Current true maximum Sleep Point capacity; wiki totals have shown internal inconsistencies.

rules.name: Achievement rewards
facts: Achievements can award Sleep Points or permanent combat damage bonuses.
Achievement tiers use increasing Sleep Point or damage rewards.
unknowns: The current wiki Achievement page contains inconsistent total counts/totals, so aggregate maximum Sleep Point calculations should not be treated as locked.

rules.name: Mining speed
facts: Every 2 Mining levels after an ore unlock reduces the ticks required to mine it by 1.
Meteor and Piles use 10-level intervals instead.
Better pickaxes provide speed buffs.

rules.name: Woodcutting speed
facts: Higher Woodcutting levels and better axes improve chopping speed.
The current knowledge model should use explicit tree/tool data where available instead of assuming Mining's formula applies.

rules.name: Worship Points and abilities
facts: Worship Points begin at 1 and capacity increases by 1 per Worship level.
Cemeteries refill Worship Points.
Worship abilities have explicit level and WP costs.

safeNow: recipe material totals already represented in structured equipment data
pendingUserObservation: Sleep Point costs and zero-Sleep behaviour by activity type

playerApiContract.principle: The UI normalizes all player sources into one snapshot shape. v1.5 first tries to read the official public FlatMMO profile page directly from the browser; if browser cross-origin rules block that request, it fails cleanly. The eventual official API replaces only the provider adapter.

interimProvider.name: official_public_profile_html
limitations: Direct browser fetch depends on flatmmo.com allowing cross-origin reads from the Companion origin.
This interim provider does not promise bank, inventory, equipment, quests, collections, or live state.

manualProvider.policy: User-entered levels are unverified. Blank skills stay unknown. Saving replaces the current snapshot; it does not merge public XP with edited levels. Username-only portable links do not include these levels.

playerApiContract.refreshPolicy: A failed refresh retains only the same username snapshot, preserving its source and timestamp and marking refreshFailed. Changing username clears previous levels. Superseded responses are ignored. Browser persistence is optional.
